87 products mein se koi bhi clean nahi hai. Har ek product description aur title mein “cure”, “treats”, “supports immunity” jaise words hain — yeh FSSAI ke liye serious risk hai.

Top violations:
- Anardana Goli → “cure”
- Vasaka Powder → “for productive cough”
- Tulsi Powder → “supports immune wellness”
- Triphala, Shatavari, Safed Musli — sab mein same issue.

Blogs mein bhi 30+ posts mein “benefits”, “transform”, “unlock” jaise claims hain — sab rewrite ki zaroorat hai.

Categories bhi galat hain: “Liver Care” → “Liver Wellness” karna hoga.

Product titles bhi fix karne hain — “For productive cough”, “Supports Immune Wellness” — yeh sab nahi chalega.
